C0890.title: Bo Software Illegally Collected Over 2.87 Million Hospital Registration Records of Patients
C0890.summary: Between 2015 and 2020, while developing and maintaining an online hospital registration system, Bo Software Co., Ltd., under the direction of its legal representative He, had employees illegally obtain and store patient registration data.
